title: simulation result.json contract (schema_version 1)
description: Complete contract for asic/<module>/Verification/simulation/result.json. On status=fail, stage_specific.{failure_phase, fail_reason} are required (if/then below); fail_reason is the one-line failure narrative, and failure_phase identifies which sub-step (prerequisite/compile/smoke/regress/coverage/conformance) tripped. Both are absent on pass. Only routing-relevant fields are enumerated below; informational fields (total_cases, coverage_summary, etc.) live free under additionalProperties.

plan_digest.description: SHA256 hex over scaffold-specification.json bytes + a NUL separator + verification-plan.md bytes (the TB's only upstream inputs). Written by sim finalize on the pass (--phase final) and freeze-eligible fail (--phase regress) paths via the shared sim.classify.plan_digest(). The classify-delta verb compares it against the current plan to select the TB-freeze branch: equal digest + a TB-valid baseline (status=pass, or status=fail with failure_phase in {regress, coverage}) + a real (non-'unavailable') baseline conformance-review.json => freeze. Localized to the simulation stage; not a routing input.
